brief: The train's main-green gate tells pending from failed (Lean flow study K15; expedite, it misleads the operator today). At main e7c66485 on 2026-10-21, 30 checks had concluded and 7 were in flight; the only failures were record and record-autofix, red because the record beat was owed; yet the --overlap gate logged that main is not green and should be reverted. Judge main on the latest run of each context only; a queued or in-progress run is wait, never red; count only the contexts the ruleset main-protect-checks requires, read live, never record, record-autofix, nightly-status or delivery-status. One owner for 'is main red': share the classifier the open #2570 gives the tick's MAIN section rather than writing a second. Controls: the e7c66485 shape (pending plus record reds) reads wait or green, not red; a failed required context reads red; an unreadable ruleset is a refusal, never green; mutants for each arm. Revision 7 widens it into the one owner of state classification for the train, the merge seat and the tick: (b) a check-run whose status is in_progress or queued while its workflow run has completed is stale, not pending: re-run that run once and re-read (2026-10-21: #2559's budget-raise-gate check-run 119308796140 stayed in_progress over a completed successful run, mergeStateStatus read BLOCKED, and the merge seat burned 8 attempts); (c) a pull request reported DIRTY is classified from git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head>: the conflicted files are named first, and the claimnotes repair is offered only when every conflicted file is a claim file; a content conflict returns to the owning fixer and its verdict does not carry (2026-10-21: the tick told #2569 to absorb main with the claimnotes driver while the conflict was content in roster_edit.py); (d) a head is reviewable only when no required context's latest run there has concluded failure. If the fixer has already started on (a), (b) to (d) are its second pull request.
